description: Blazor Wrapper for ApexGantt library - A powerful JavaScript Gantt chart library for creating interactive project timelines and task management visualizations.
releaseNotes:
1.6.0 Update ApexGantt core to 3.23.1. UpdateOptionsAsync now clears a Calendar, Pack or other locale setting set to null, so Pack = null returns a live chart to English. Localization: LocaleOptions.Pack names a bundled locale pack ("ja", Japanese), loaded on demand, which translates every message and sets Japanese header word order, YYYY/MM/DD dates and Monday weeks; LocaleOptions gains Tag, DisplayDateFormat, CrosshairFormat and TimelineHeaderFormat (per tier Top and Sub rows as a pattern string, width-gated candidates or a JsFunction, plus a Fiscal block used only while a fiscal year is in use). CalendarOptions gains WeekStart (0 to 6) and FiscalYearStartMonth (1 to 12); a calendar with only these two shapes the header and does not turn the working calendar on, and an explicit FiscalYearStartMonth, 1 included, turns fiscal-year labels on. Every Messages key, the former function keys included, now takes a template string. Behaviour changes from the core: InputDateFormat reads more tokens (Q, Do, k, w, W, X, x and L now print values, so wrap literal letters in [ ]), search matches full-width and other compatibility forms, the quick filter waits for an IME composition to end, and the default tooltips and edit dialog show task names as text instead of HTML.

      1.5.0 Update ApexGantt core to 3.21.0. Opt-in Ignite UI theming: set ApexGanttConfiguration.IgniteUI = true and charts take their bar, grid, text and surface colours, font and light or dark variant from the Ignite UI theme on the page; the add-on is free and needs no license key, and GanttOptions.DesignSystem = false turns it off for one chart. GanttOptions gains ThemeName (a theme registered by name, or "light" or "dark"), Tokens and DesignSystem. Behaviour change from the core: an option passed to the chart now beats the chart's own CSS variable for the same setting (before, the CSS variable won).

      1.4.0 Update ApexGantt core to 3.20.0. New methods: GetTaskAsync, GetTasksAsync and GetDependenciesAsync (copies of the chart's data, edits included, for saving), ExpandTaskAsync and CollapseTaskAsync, ScrollToTaskAsync(id, expand), UpdateTaskAsync(id, updates, silent) and UpdateOptionsAsync. UpdateAsync() now sends the tasks only when the task list changed, so an option change keeps the edits made in the chart and the undo history (UpdateAsync(replaceTasks: true) reloads the list as before). TaskUpdateEventArgs and TaskUpdateSuccessEventArgs gain Source (TaskUpdateSource constants: api, dialog, drag, inline, keyboard, progress, resize); with 3.20 these events fire for every edit path, so an app that saves on both OnTaskDragged and OnTaskUpdateSuccess saves a drag twice. GanttTask.BarTextColor and GanttTaskInfo.BarTextColor added; DependencyLinkInfo added. TaskDependency.LagUnit and the LagUnit enum are [Obsolete]: they never had an effect. AddDependencyAsync now throws for a self-link, a cycle or a summary-descendant link. Only a Premium or higher licence key removes the watermark.

      1.3.0 Update ApexGantt core to 3.15.0 (from ~3.11). Load the core as a self-contained ES module (no script tag or CDN needed). Port the expanded 3.15 API: dependencies-as-objects with lag/type, baselines, working calendar, assignees, task segments, summary bars, column configuration, sorting/grouping/filtering, critical path, crosshair, undo/redo history, and many appearance options; add all 20 core events and a public method API (task CRUD, dependencies, undo/redo, sort/group/filter, columns, selection, zoom, export). Note: the obsolete ViewMode and EnableToolbar options were removed (use PixelsPerDay and the toolbar options); per-task Color/ClassName/CustomData were replaced by BarBackgroundColor/RowBackgroundColor and inline additional data.

      1.2.0 License Manager
      1.0.0 Initial release
